commit.message: Say request in the summary, candidate in the skip message and drop the second sort
Say so when there was no threshold change in the window
Close the last candidate's window before releasing the loaders and say candidate until corroborated
Tie the corroborating event to the failing load, exclude Shenandoah and call the failure a candidate until it is corroborated
Require a threshold change or a metadata GC after the failed allocation, tighten the tolerance and narrow the summary to what the recording covers
Skip on any allocation failure before loading started and say request where the code means request
Decide contamination before the sample checks and fix the wording
Skip when another allocation failure or a threshold change comes before the test's own request
Check the default MetaspaceSize, allow a higher threshold after the request and fix the comments
Stop loading only on the qualifying allocation failure, take the threshold from the sample and treat the default size like an explicit one
Sample into the recording, anchor on the failed allocation inside loadOneClass and skip when startup moved the threshold
Run with MinMetaspaceFreeRatio=0 so other collections cannot move the threshold ahead of the first metadata GC
Sample committed and the threshold before each class load and check the sample taken before the failing one
Anchor the checks on the metadata allocation failure and check committed at the request
Take the expand_and_allocate request as the first metadata GC on a concurrent collector and dump the recording on failure
Read the threshold when loading starts and check the threshold the metadata GC was requested at
